channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, praises recent global tightening with 'no free riders'
item.description: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.

item.title: Marco Rubio to visit Indian billionaire Ambani's refinery in Gujarat as U.S. diesel prices surge
item.description: Not only is Ambani's Reliance investing in a U.S. refinery and buying Venezuelan oil, but its strong ability to supply diesel has put Jamnagar on the map during Rubio's visit.

item.title: One Singapore ship was sunk, but here's why others are still transiting the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Singapore vessels are set to continue navigating the perilous Strait of Hormuz despite attacks on two container ships, said maritime experts.

item.title: Trump says he won't use nuclear weapons or send ground troops to Iran
item.description: Trump said he would not use nuclear weapons against Iran or send ground troops as the U.S. reportedly weighs new strike options.

item.title: Zelenskyy praises 'real leaders' in Europe, as his strained relationship with Trump overshadows EU summit
item.description: Zelenskyy's strained relationship with Trump is clouding the EU summit focused on securing further support for Ukraine.

item.title: The IPO drought is driving private equity-owned companies to the debt market to pay investors
item.description: Private equity firms are increasingly using debt-funded dividend recaps to return cash to investors as exits remain subdued.

item.title: Russia returns to G20 table in Bangkok on U.S. invitation that angers Europe
item.description: Russia’s return to the G20 table has tested how far Washington’s outreach to Moscow will strain ties with European allies.

item.title: The problem with 'good debt': Why borrowers should think twice about the label
item.description: Mortgages and student loans are often called "good debt." Experts say that label can hide the real question: Can you actually afford the risk?

item.title: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House, Reuters reports
item.description: Officials say the White House ordered temporary limits on Ukraine’s Starshield service, affecting drone operations amid rising U.S.-Kyiv tensions.

item.title: Hybe shares jump 10% as K-pop sensation BTS' tour lifts earnings hopes
item.description: BTS' world tour and rising global demand for newer K-pop acts are fueling earnings expectations, sending Hybe shares soaring.

item.title: What to know about Starshield, SpaceX's military-focused Starlink service
item.description: Elon Musk distinguished Starshield from Starlink, which he said could not be used for offensive military operations.

item.title: KFC to switch to Coca-Cola beverages in U.S. restaurants for the first time in decades
item.description: KFC is switching from PepsiCo to Coca-Cola as its beverage supplier for U.S. restaurants.

item.title: People in China are spending nearly as much of their income as Americans on healthcare
item.description: Increasing government spending on healthcare could help boost consumption in China, the International Monetary Fund said.

item.title: CoreWeave credit default swaps hit distress levels as investors sour on AI debt
item.description: Signs of distressed deepened in CoreWeave on Thursday.

item.title: Netflix Chief Content Officer Bela Bajaria is leaving, will be replaced by Peter Rice
item.description: Netflix announced Bela Bajaria will be replaced by former Disney exec Peter Rice as the company's chief content officer.

item.title: This semiconductor stock is not for the faint of heart. Here's why I see opportunity
item.description: Lam Research shares have pulled back from their June high as AI demand boosts chipmaking equipment, memory and advanced packaging.

item.title: She made college ‘good debt’ for herself. Can she do the same for her daughter?
item.description: A generation ago, it was more common to put yourself through school. For reasons including rising education costs, It's a feat that's now far less manageable.

item.title: Who gets to have 'good debt'? A sociologist, theologian, philosopher and other experts weigh in
item.description: Humans have debated the merits and morality of debt throughout history.

item.title: Trump says 'if Ken Paxton loses' Texas Senate race, blame Cornyn and Karl Rove
item.description: Polls show GOP Attorney General Ken Paxton trailing Democratic Rep. James Talarico in the Texas Senate race.

item.title: India's rupee forecast to weaken toward 100-per-dollar level even as RBI pushes back
item.description: The RBI's latest moves have helped the rupee recover from 96.79 rupees per dollar to the 95-level over recent days.

item.title: Here's our monthly update on our 32 stocks, including 2 more names to buy
item.description: Jim Cramer identified two of his favorite stocks to buy and the names he's not willing to touch just yet.

item.description: You can maximize your Citi ThankYou® Points with this combination of Citi credit cards.

item.title: Gasping for clean air: Singapore battles relentless haze as Prime Minister Wong warns of action
item.description: Singapore continues to grapple with severe haze that is disrupting daily life and businesses, as authorities roll out protective measures — and issue warnings.

item.title: Retirees can take these steps to shore up income as yields rise and some dividend-paying sectors slip
item.description: A spike in Treasury yields has retirees facing price declines from their bonds, as well as in some of their favorite dividend-paying sectors.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Billionaire Ambani’s mega-IPO faces a valuation reality check amid Musk spat
item.description: Jio Platforms, the company at the center of Musk’s remarks, is launching an IPO later this month.

item.title: Porsche reveals Mission S concept car that previews new design identity
item.description: Porsche revealed a concept car called Mission S as part of a turnaround plan that includes efforts to boost profits through higher-end products and lower sales.

item.title: Tesla reveals next-generation Roadster after almost a decade of delays
item.description: Elon Musk first debuted the Roadster refresh concept in 2017 but Tesla has since missed every targeted delivery date.

item.title: Friday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: Investors shunned corners of the AI trade on Thursday. The Dow gained more than 550 points, benefiting from the rotation away from some tech names.

item.title: U.S. sues California in fight over checking citizenship of mail voters
item.description: The lawsuit by the Trump administration comes less than a month before the midterm election that will determine which party controls both chambers of Congress.

item.title: Penske Automotive agrees to be taken private by Penske, Mitsui
item.description: Penske Automotive will be taken private by its two largest shareholders at a value of $16.3 billion, the company announced Thursday.
